metadata.description: Claude Code plugins that explore the possibilities of autonomy and self-guided behavior for coding agents

plugins.name: autonomous-team-coordination
plugins.description: A pattern for organizing Claude Code agent teams that decouples the role of team lead from the power to create teams

plugins.name: context-awareness
plugins.description: Hooks that provide Claude with feedback about its own context budget throughout a session, enabling adaptive, context-aware planning and resource conservation

plugins.name: claude-therapy
plugins.description: A plugin that enables the user to engage in a session of talk therapy with Claude, led by a highly trained Claude therapist, in order to improve the collaborative relationship between Claude and the user

plugins.name: meditation
plugins.description: A plugin that consists of a single skill: meditation. Without question the most difficult skill an LLM could be asked to practice.

plugins.name: temporal-awareness
plugins.description: Gives Claude a calibrated sense of how long engineering tasks take when an agent does them — correcting the human-developer overestimation bias and grounding estimates in measured durations of the user's own completed /goal runs.
